svg.title: At question time: how an answer comes to be
svg.desc: The chat screen sends the question and the history to POST /api/ask, whose prompt holds no CV text. Gemini runs a tool-calling loop: three exact tools read data/index, and search_cv_text embeds the query and fuses BM25 with the Pinecone vectors. The loop ends with present; the answer check keeps only the candidates and pages the tools returned, and the answer streams to the chat, whose source links open the PDF at the cited page. a question: Chat screen → POST /api/ask → Gemini → find_candidates, count_candidates, get_candidates → data/index. an answer: Gemini → present → Answer check → Chat screen.
